text.en:
Item B-343.12, for Mountain Province, page one hundred sixty-A, title B, appendix A of Republic Act Numbered Fourteen hundred eleven, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"B-343.12:
Balaoa-Cagubatan via Mayag Road Construction"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1957.
